description: The works of our catalog that are similar to ONE artwork (the list its page shows under "similar artworks"), best first. Use it for "show me works like this one", or to propose something else when the artwork asked for is not what the person wants. Give the pk of the artwork (from a search tool, or the page the person is on). Returns similar_to (the artwork itself), results with pk, artist_name, title, year, url and image_url, and similar_artworks_page (the page that shows them all). An empty list means we hold no similar works for it: search by artist, movement or subject then. It does not search by words: for a title or a description, use find_artwork_in_catalog or search_artworks.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

pk.description: The artwork pk, as returned by a search tool.

name: get_similar_artworks
title: Artworks similar to one artwork
